audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly names 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' as Hwei's key ability to track — this is not one of his five real abilities (P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair). The packet's own defects flag names never being used. Also missing: Hwei can cancel Bone Skewer's channel with a Q or E cast (both flagged hardCC).
audit.why: The kit file lists Subject: Torment (E) as the CC-bearing spellbook ('crowd control abilities'); Q also carries a hardCC flag. 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' is a fabricated composite name (calibration precedent: Brand's 'Ares of Blaze', Nilah's 'Jag'talon Slash').
audit.corrected: Replaced the fabricated name with the real ability (Subject: Torment, E) in focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1] and dontsFull[2], and added the channel-cancel warning.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Ghostwater Dive banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Hwei Subject: Torment (E): 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s cd — all his CC lives here, dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Duo tempo bends around it. - Keep W Ghostwater Dive banked for his best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
